tickets.title: Cart total ignores quantity
tickets.description: Adding 2 pens at $5.00 and 1 ink at $1.50 shows a total of $6.50 instead of $11.50: cartTotal in src/cart.ts adds the unit price once per line and ignores qty. Fix it.

tickets.title: Show a message for an empty cart
tickets.description: An empty cart renders an empty list. Make renderCart in src/cart.ts return a paragraph that says the cart is empty, so the page tells the shopper what is going on.
criteria:
renderCart([]) returns the string '

Your cart is empty

'
renderCart with items still returns the list
